scope: All fixed mesh pairs once, every moving mesh against the full machine at 193 keys plus 192 half-frames independently in source and GLB.
limitations: Sampled clearance, not continuous rigid-body simulation.
Belt surfaces are fixed running paths; pulleys and rigid shafts are animated. Grain travel on the leather is not simulated.
